title: Pinned vertex comparisons and the overlap vertical-pasting identity
statement: Let g′:X′→X, f′:X′→S′, f:X→S and g:S′→S form a cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change]. Assume the derived module categories of all schemes exist [def-pc-derived-category]. Let K∈D(O_X), K′∈D(O_X′), φ:L(g′)K→K′ and U,V arbitrary opens in X. Set F=Lg*Rf* and G=Rf′* [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Form the two exact-restriction rows T and T′ of [def-pc-rf-mv-base-change-components], using its fixed mvOpenRestrictionAdjunctions, overlap U∩V and inverse-image overlap, and zero third arrows (zero is just a placeholder, with no distinguishedness asserted). Form the pinned local arrows a(W) of [def-pc-relative-mv-maps]. There exist isomorphisms e₂:F(T₂)≅a(U).left⊕a(V).left, e₃:F(T₃)≅a(U∩V).left, e₂′:G(T₂′)≅a(U).right⊕a(V).right and e₃′:G(T₃′)≅a(U∩V).right. The four identities F(T.mor₁)≫e₂.hom=relativeMVSourceFirst, F(T.mor₂)≫e₃.hom=e₂.hom≫relativeMVSourceSecond, G(T′.mor₁)≫e₂′.hom=relativeMVTargetFirst and G(T′.mor₂)≫e₃′.hom=e₂′.hom≫relativeMVTargetSecond hold. Finally mvBaseChangeOpenMap(U∩V)≫e₃′.hom=e₃.hom≫a(U∩V).hom. No cover, compactness, quasi-coherence, distinguishedness, connecting morphism or triangle morphism is assumed or concluded.

proof.text: Use the explicit exact-open comparison E and its proved unit identity. Apply Lg* to E on U,V,W to define the three source-open isomorphisms. Obtain the inverse-image-open family t with unit, individual restriction, and pasted-mate identities.

Define both middle isomorphisms by the additive functor mapBiprod comparison followed by biprod.mapIso on the two open comparisons. The local private map_lift_comparison proves the lift transport by biproduct projection extensionality. Apply it with the source unit identity and the target unit formulas. The local private map_desc_comparison cancels mapBiprod.inv and uses biproduct inclusion extensionality; functor additivity carries the negative V summand. Apply it to the two mapped source inclusion formulas and the two target inclusion formulas. For the last identity specialize the pasted-mate formula at U∩V.

theorem relativeMV_pinned_vertex_comparisons
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (hpull : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K') (U V : X.Opens) :
    let F := schemeDerivedDirectImage f ⋙ derivedPullback g
    let G := schemeDerivedDirectImage f'
    let T := mvBaseChangeTriangle X U V (U ⊓ V) (homOfLE inf_le_left)
      (homOfLE inf_le_right) (mvOpenRestrictionAdjunction X U)
      (mvOpenRestrictionAdjunction X V) (mvOpenRestrictionAdjunction X (U ⊓ V)) K 0
    let T' := mvBaseChangeTriangle X' (g' ⁻¹ᵁ U) (g' ⁻¹ᵁ V) (g' ⁻¹ᵁ (U ⊓ V))
      ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map g'.base).map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U)))
      ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map g'.base).map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V)))
      (mvOpenRestrictionAdjunction X' (g' ⁻¹ᵁ U))
      (mvOpenRestrictionAdjunction X' (g' ⁻¹ᵁ V))
      (mvOpenRestrictionAdjunction X' (g' ⁻¹ᵁ (U ⊓ V))) K' 0
    let a := relativeMVLocalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ
    ∃ (e₂ : F.obj T.obj₂ ≅ (a U).left ⊞ (a V).left)
      (e₃ : F.obj T.obj₃ ≅ (a (U ⊓ V)).left)
      (e₂' : G.obj T'.obj₂ ≅ (a U).right ⊞ (a V).right)
      (e₃' : G.obj T'.obj₃ ≅ (a (U ⊓ V)).right),
      F.map T.mor₁ ≫ e₂.hom = relativeMVSourceFirst f g U V K ∧
      F.map T.mor₂ ≫ e₃.hom = e₂.hom ≫ relativeMVSourceSecond f g U V K ∧
      G.map T'.mor₁ ≫ e₂'.hom = relativeMVTargetFirst g' f' U V K' ∧
      G.map T'.mor₂ ≫ e₃'.hom = e₂'.hom ≫ relativeMVTargetSecond g' f' U V K' ∧
      mvBaseChangeOpenMap f f' g g' hpull.w K K' φ (U ⊓ V) ≫ e₃'.hom =
        e₃.hom ≫ (a (U ⊓ V)).hom
